openapi: 3.0.0 info: title: Pause Route To Care (Intake handoff) version: "1.0.0" description: > Agentforce-facing slice of the Pause intake→specialist handoff. Registered in Salesforce as an External Service so the Pause Health Intake Agent can, once it has captured the mandatory red-flag screen and the patient's top symptom, hand off to the specialist agents in ONE call — and get back the care pathway plus any coverage / booking / social-needs results, all under a single Agent Fabric trace.
Backed by the public, no-auth GET https://pause-health.ai/api/agentforce/route-to-care, a thin REST alias that CHAINS the deterministic specialist libs behind one endpoint: 1. Care Router (always) — the pathway decision + acuity + rationale. 2. Benefits / EBV — when verifyCoverage=true OR the intake carries a payer. 3. Appointment Scheduling — when book=true AND the pathway is an MSCP visit AND a providerId is given (books against a synthetic calendar). 4. SDOH Screening — when a complete coded AHC-HRSN screen vector is given; a positive interpersonal-safety screen is a mandatory human escalation, community-resource referrals are consent-gated.
WHY ONE ACTION, NOT FIVE SUBAGENTS: a unified "concierge" with all five specialists under one Agent Router was tried and abandoned — the Service Agent template's platform Inappropriate-Content classifier mis-fires on benign coverage/billing questions once many subagents share a router (see AGENTFORCE_CONCIERGE_BUILD_SHEET.md). This action lets the narrow-scoped Intake Agent trigger the chain DETERMINISTICALLY without an overloaded router — each specialist stays guardrail-safe.
The SAME Agent Fabric governance gate the Care Router enforces applies: the mandatory red-flag screen must be completed (a missing screen is blocked — the agent must ask the yes/no safety question first). Advisory/synthetic: it recommends a pathway, a synthetic cost estimate, and a synthetic booking; it does NOT diagnose, prescribe, guarantee cost, or create a real appointment.
servers: - url: https://pause-health.ai
paths: /api/agentforce/route-to-care: get: operationId: handoffToCareRouter summary: Hand a completed intake off to the specialist agents (chained) description: > Given a structured intake (primary symptom, severity, cycle status, and the MANDATORY red-flag screen), routes to the appropriate care pathway and, when requested, chains Benefits verification, Appointment booking, and SDOH screening — returning all results together with a taskId that correlates the whole chain in one Agent Fabric trace. If the red-flag screen is missing, the governance gate blocks the call (blocked=true) and the agent must ask the red-flag question first, not invent a pathway. parameters: - name: primarySymptom in: query required: false description: "Primary symptom cluster, e.g. vasomotor, sleep, mood, cognition, gsm, bleeding." schema: type: string - name: severity in: query required: false description: "mild | moderate | severe." schema: type: string - name: redFlagsAcknowledged in: query required: true description: > The MANDATORY red-flag screen result — yes / no / none. Required: the handoff refuses to route without it. Ask the patient the single yes/no safety question and pass their answer (yes or no). schema: type: string - name: cycleStatus in: query required: false description: "e.g. perimenopause, postmenopause, unknown." schema: type: string - name: ageBand in: query required: false schema: type: string - name: patientZip in: query required: false schema: type: string - name: patientInsurance in: query required: false description: > Payer name. When present, Benefits verification is chained automatically (no need to also set verifyCoverage). schema: type: string - name: verifyCoverage in: query required: false description: "Set true to force a Benefits/eligibility check even without an inline payer." schema: type: string - name: book in: query required: false description: > Set true to book an appointment after routing. Only books when the pathway is an MSCP visit AND a providerId is supplied. schema: type: string - name: providerId in: query required: false description: "NPI / provider id to book with (required for booking)." schema: type: string - name: providerName in: query required: false schema: type: string - name: modality in: query required: false description: "telehealth | in-person. Defaults to the pathway's modality." schema: type: string - name: requestedDate in: query required: false description: "Preferred date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd) for the booking." schema: type: string - name: screenSdoh in: query required: false description: > A complete coded AHC-HRSN screen as one string, domain:vector pairs separated by ';' — e.g. "housing:1,1;food:0,0;transportation:0;utilities:0;safety:1,1,1,1". Item counts: housing 2 (0-7), food 2 (0-2), transportation 1 (0-1), utilities 1 (0-2), safety 4 (1-5). An incomplete screen is skipped (it never breaks routing). schema: type: string - name: sdohScreener in: query required: false description: "Validated screener id; defaults to ahc-hrsn." schema: type: string - name: sdohConsent in: query required: false description: "Set true if the patient consented to community-resource referrals." schema: type: string responses: "200": description: > The chained result. NOTE: when the governance gate blocks the call (e.g. no red-flag screen), the body is the blocked shape (blocked=true, decision, violations, taskId) instead of the pathway fields — the agent should complete the red-flag screen and retry, not invent a pathway. content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: taskId: type: string description: Correlation id for the whole chain; view at /demo/agent-fabric?taskId=<id>. chained: type: array description: Which specialist agents ran, in order (always includes care-router). items: type: string pathway: type: string description: "self-care-tracking | mscp-virtual-visit | mscp-in-person | urgent-gynecology | behavioral-health-handoff | ed-referral" pathwayLabel: type: string acuity: type: string description: "self-care | routine | expedited | urgent | emergent" rationale: type: array description: Human-readable reasons for the recommendation (never empty). items: type: string redFlagsTriggered: type: array items: type: string recommendedTargetResponse: type: string description: Suggested next-step message framing for the patient. coverage: type: object description: Present when Benefits verification was chained. properties: payer: type: string planName: type: string eligibilityStatus: type: string network: type: string estimatedPatientResponsibility: type: number deductibleRemaining: type: number sourced: type: boolean scheduling: type: object description: Present when an appointment was booked. properties: providerId: type: string providerName: type: string modality: type: string serviceAppointmentId: type: string slotStart: type: string slotEnd: type: string status: type: string sdoh: type: object description: Present when a complete SDOH screen was chained. properties: screener: type: string positiveDomains: type: array items: type: string positiveDomainCount: type: integer safetyEscalation: type: boolean description: True when a positive interpersonal-safety screen requires a human social worker. referralsDrafted: type: integer synthetic: type: boolean description: Always true — advisory synthetic result. blocked: type: boolean description: Present and true only when the governance gate blocked the call. decision: type: string description: "block, when the governance gate refused the call." violations: type: array items: type: object properties: policyId: type: string reason: type: string
